metric_definitions.relative_search_interest: Google Trends normalized search popularity index (0-100) relative to the cohort peak week and term. Not absolute search volume.
metric_definitions.cohort_relative_search_share: Proportion (%) of total cohort relative search interest for the same period. Defined only within the closed four-brand cohort; not total footwear market share.
metric_definitions.is_low_volume: True when Google Trends reported '<1', denoting detectable sub-unit interest (0 < interest < 1) below 1% of peak interest.
